newsitem.title: USA: Physician gets extension on workers' comp unit.
newsitem.headline: Physician gets extension on workers' comp unit.

text.p: Physician Corp of America said Monday the State of Florida granted the company a 30-day extension on its scheduled court hearing relating to its workers' compensation subsidiary.
Physician Corp said it has developed several viable proposals to resolve the insolvency of its workers' compensation subsidiary and expects to be able to reach a resolution before June 2.
Physician Corp said strategic discussions relating to the sale of the company and other strategic options are continuing.

Physician Corp also posted first quarter earnings of $4.6 million or $0.12 a share on total revenues of $365.5 million, compared with a loss of $4.9 million or $0.13 a share on total revenues of $378.9 million last year.
